&FORCE_EVAL
  &DFT
    &KPOINTS
      SCHEME MONKHORST-PACK 2 2 2
    &END KPOINTS
    &SCF
      EPS_SCF 1.0E-6
      SCF_GUESS ATOMIC
      ADDED_MOS 20
      &SMEAR ON
        METHOD FERMI_DIRAC
        ELECTRONIC_TEMPERATURE [K] 300
      &END SMEAR
      &MIXING
        METHOD BROYDEN_MIXING
        ALPHA 0.2
        BETA 1.5
        NBROYDEN 8
      &END MIXING
    &END SCF
  &END DFT
&END FORCE_EVAL
